# SenCID (biomart does not map all the gene names to ensembl ids)
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
mart <- useMart(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
sheets <- excel_sheets(here::here("SenCID", "mmc4.xlsx"))
SID_sheets <- sheets[grep("_marker", sheets)]

lapply(SID_sheets, function(sheet) {
  marker <- read_excel(here::here("SenCID", "mmc4.xlsx"), sheet = sheet)
  ensembl_ids <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","hgnc_symbol"),
                       filters = "hgnc_symbol", values = marker[["...1"]],
                       mart = mart)
  ensembl_ids <- ensembl_ids[! duplicated(ensembl_ids$hgnc_symbol), ]
  colnames(ensembl_ids) <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

  marker <- marker %>%
    filter(! (is.na(SID_DEG))) %>%
    rename("gene_symbol" = "...1") %>% 
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC) %>%
    left_join(ensembl_ids, by = "gene_symbol") %>%
    relocate(ensembl_id, gene_symbol) %>%
    filter(! is.na(ensembl_id))

  write.table(marker, here::here("SenCID", paste0(sheet, ".gEAR.tab")), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
})

```

# Hernandez-Segura 
```{r}
prep_sig <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    #filter(padj < 0.05) %>% # the results are already filtered to 0.05
    dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Gene_Names, log2FoldChange) %>%
    rename("gene_symbol" = "Gene_Names", "ensembl_id" = "Ensembl_ID")
  return(df)
}

# FIBROBLAST SIGNATURES
sheets <- excel_sheets(here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "mmc2.xls"))

# Oncogene induced senescence
ois <- read_excel(here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "mmc2.xls"), sheet = "Data S1B", skip = 3)
ois_reformat <- prep_sig(ois) 
write.table(ois_reformat, here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "Hernandez-Segura_OIS_Fibroblast.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

# Replicative senescence
rs <- read_excel(here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "mmc2.xls"), sheet = "Data S1C", skip = 3)
rs_reformat <- rs %>%
  filter(`NB-GLM_adjPval` < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Gene_names, `NB-GLM_FC`) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = "Gene_names", "ensembl_id" = "Ensembl_ID")
write.table(rs_reformat, here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "Hernandez-Segura_RS_Fibroblast.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

# Ionizing-Radiation induced senescence
iris <- read_excel(here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "mmc2.xls"), sheet = "Data S1D", skip = 2)
iris_reformat <- iris %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Gene_names, log2FoldChange) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = "Gene_names", "ensembl_id" = "Ensembl_ID")
write.table(iris_reformat, here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "Hernandez-Segura_IRIS_Fibroblast.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

# Fibroblast Senescence
fib <- read_excel(here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "mmc2.xls"), sheet = "Data S1E", skip = 2)
fib_reformat <- fib %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Gene_names, `Meta_NB-GLM_FC`) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = "Gene_names", "ensembl_id" = "Ensembl_ID")
write.table(fib_reformat, here::here("Hernandez-Segura", "Hernandez-Segura_Sen_Fibroblast.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```

# Moiseeva
```{r}
sheets <- excel_sheets(here::here("Moiseeva", "41586_2022_5535_MOESM13_ESM.xlsx"))

comp <- read_excel(here::here("Moiseeva", "41586_2022_5535_MOESM13_ESM.xlsx"), sheet = "Ext.Fig.5d", skip = 2, n_max = 1)
groups <- c(colnames(comp)[grep("Young", colnames(comp))],
            colnames(comp)[grep("Geriatric", colnames(comp))])

sigs <- read_excel(here::here("Moiseeva", "41586_2022_5535_MOESM13_ESM.xlsx"), sheet = "Ext.Fig.5d", skip = 3)
res_cols <- split(colnames(sigs), rep(1:12, each = 5))
names(res_cols) <- groups
res_list <- lapply(res_cols, function(res) {
  sig <- sigs %>% 
    select(all_of(res))
  colnames(sig) <- str_remove(colnames(sig), pattern = "\\.\\.\\.[0-9]+")
  sig %>% 
    drop_na(padj) %>%
    select(ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol, log2FoldChange) %>%
    rename("ensembl_id" = "ensembl_gene_id", "gene_symbol" = "mgi_symbol")
})

lapply(names(res_list), function(res) {
  fname <- gsub(" ", "_", res)
  write.table(res_list[[res]], here::here("Moiseeva", paste0("Moiseeva_", fname, ".gEAR.tab")), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
})

```

# Xu Aggregated SnG module
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
mart <- useMart(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
sheets <- excel_sheets(here::here("Xu", "13024_2021_507_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"))

sig <- read_excel(here::here("Xu", "13024_2021_507_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"), sheet = "Table S6", skip = 1)

ensembl_ids <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","hgnc_symbol"),
                     filters = "hgnc_symbol", values = sig$Symbol,
                     mart = mart)
ensembl_ids <- ensembl_ids[! duplicated(ensembl_ids$hgnc_symbol), ]
colnames(ensembl_ids) <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

sig.gear <- sig %>%
  dplyr::select(Symbol, Weight) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = Symbol) %>%
  left_join(ensembl_ids, by = "gene_symbol") %>%
  relocate(ensembl_id, gene_symbol) %>%
  filter(! is.na(ensembl_id))

write.table(sig.gear, here::here("Xu", "Agg_SnG_module.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```


# Cherry SnC vs Quiescent Fibroblast, in monoculture or co-cultured wth Macrophages
```{r}
library(biomaRt)

# Methods states alignment was to GRCm38.p6
mart <- useMart(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl", host = "https://nov2020.archive.ensembl.org")

# SnC vs Quiescent Fibroblasts in monoculture
sig1 <- read.csv(here::here("Cherry", "2021_EliseSnCvQSN_Monoculture.csv"), header = TRUE)

ensembl_ids <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","mgi_symbol"),
                     filters = "mgi_symbol", values = sig1$X,
                     mart = mart)
ensembl_ids <- ensembl_ids[! duplicated(ensembl_ids$mgi_symbol), ]
colnames(ensembl_ids) <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

sig1.gear <- sig1 %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(X, stat) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = X) %>%
  left_join(ensembl_ids, by = "gene_symbol") %>%
  relocate(ensembl_id, gene_symbol) %>%
  filter(! is.na(ensembl_id))

write.table(sig1.gear, here::here("Cherry", "SnC_vs_Quiescent_Fib.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

# SnC vs Quiescent Fibroblasts co-cultured with Macrophages
sig2 <- read.csv(here::here("Cherry", "2021_EliseSnCvQSN_MacCoculture.csv"), header = TRUE)

ensembl_ids <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","mgi_symbol"),
                     filters = "mgi_symbol", values = sig2$X,
                     mart = mart)
ensembl_ids <- ensembl_ids[! duplicated(ensembl_ids$mgi_symbol), ]
colnames(ensembl_ids) <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

sig2.gear <- sig2 %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(X, stat) %>%
  rename("gene_symbol" = X) %>%
  left_join(ensembl_ids, by = "gene_symbol") %>%
  relocate(ensembl_id, gene_symbol) %>%
  filter(! is.na(ensembl_id))

write.table(sig2.gear, here::here("Cherry", "SnC_Fib_vs_Quiescent_Fib_cocultured_with_macs.gEAR.tab"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

```


# senCAF
```{r}
library(tibble)

df <- read.table(here::here("signatures", "senCAF_msigdb", "YE_BELLE_SENCAF_CONSENSUS.v2026.1.Mm.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
sig <- df %>% 
  filter(V1 == "GENE_SYMBOLS") %>%
  select(V2) %>%
  deframe()

sig <- str_split_1(sig, ",")
write.table(sig, file = here::here("signatures", "senCAF_msigdb", "senCAF.tsv"), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```
